description: Your agent can design a single screen with you: send one screen in opointo's design format (the Composition add_screen builds from) and get back a link that opens it in the App Designer as a new, unsaved design the person can change. Each problem comes back with its path and a fix. dryRun checks without making a link; format: true returns the format. For a whole app with navigation, propose_app is the matching tool.

composition.description: One screen: { name, screen: { content: { children: [node] }, chrome: { header?, headerItems?, floating: [] }, overlays: [] } }. A node is { id, slug, props }: slug is "wireframe:<block>" or a component from find_component.

dryRun.description: check the screen and report, without making a link

name: propose_screen
title: Propose a screen design
